subject: Social Media
title: Digging Up the Past
description: A short lesson to help you apply Digging Up the Past.

hook.text: A comedian gets a movie deal. Someone finds tweets from 2009. The deal dies in hours. The past returns.

buildup.text: Social media is a permanent record. Every post is archived, cached, or screenshotted by someone.

discovery.text: James Gunn lost a Disney film over old tweets. Kevin Hart lost the Oscars. Old words haunt new success.

twist.text: People grow and change. But the internet doesn't update its records. Your 2010 self speaks forever.

climax.text: Young people now curate their past, deleting anything that might age badly. A chilling effect on speech.

punchline.text: The internet remembers. Even when you've changed.

quiz.question: Why is digging up old posts problematic?
options: People change but the record doesn't
Old posts are hard to find
